title: 외국군인ㆍ군속에 대한 명예계급 수여 규정 / queue:ARTICLE:2:0:00002:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 2 (Persons Eligible for Honorary Ranks)
(1) An honorary military rank may be conferred upon a foreign service member or civilian attached to foreign armed forces who has been stationed in the Republic of Korea for at least three years and is recognized as having rendered distinguished service.
(2) No honorary rank at or above the rank of four-star general may be conferred pursuant to paragraph (1). When an honorary rank is conferred upon a military service member, the rank shall be equivalent to the member's rank in his or her home country; when conferred upon a civilian attached to foreign armed forces, the rank shall be equivalent to the rank corresponding to the treatment afforded to that person in his or her home country.
